added.summary: A TSX `<Input>` edits: focused, it takes typed text at a drawn caret, Backspace and Delete remove a whole character (an accented letter or emoji as one), the arrows, Home and End move the caret, and `onChange` fires with the field's whole text in `value`. `placeholder` shows dimmed while it is empty; `value` set from outside replaces the text. Before, an Input showed nothing and took no typing.
